adjudication_trigger: The two valid readers disagree on subtopic set, fear_relevance, fear_polarity or arc; or a reader has invalid JSON/IDs/order. Voice/stance/step granularity differences are recorded but do not alone trigger review.
adjudication_selection: Disagreement cases sorted by anonymous-song hash; at most the frozen cap, without years/artists, and remaining cases stay unresolved.
voting: At least2 matching categorical votes per field; subtopics individually require2 votes and may have at most2 consensus labels. The third review is another call to mini with anonymized prior reports; not an independent model. No calibrated confidence or majority guarantee of correctness.
narrative: 2–4 steps when supported,0when no supported arc. Argumentative relation labels differ from validated emotional intensity or universal six-shape forms.
input: Only ordered anonymous block IDs/text; same8-line/min3-word analysis segmentation, exact repetitions retained. Provider headers stripped. No year,artist,title,selection hypothesis or seedtopic in payload.
metadata_blindness_limit: Known lyrics may be recognized from pretrained knowledge; omission of explicit metadata does not guarantee unfamiliarity.
public_paraphrases: At most12words each; any five-word lyric overlap withheld. Raw responses/complete blocks remain private; model-specific votes and disagreements public.
historical_scope: Descriptive comparison within the selected balanced corpus; categories predeclared before reading, not unsupervised discovered emotion classes. Related models and repeated artists may share dependencies.
